skill.title: opencode skill
skill.description: Teaches opencode to work on tasks the same way every time: it writes the plan in PLAN.md, logs every commit in HISTORIAL.md and never pushes, opens a PR or changes JIRA without your confirmation. That way each task's details page shows the phase and the changes.
